name: ReKH CoM
description: Native PS5 homebrew port of Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories for Game Boy Advance. Supports European, US and Japanese cartridge versions in a single app, with Vulkan rendering, audio and PS5 controller input. The correct region is detected from the ROM you provide. Requires your own legally obtained GBA cartridge dump; no ROM or original game data is included.
author: AngelXex
